objective: Compute the pooled survival proportion, compare it to the group mean, and describe what the counts cannot explain.

inputs.text: This fictional nursery report begins with Moss nursery. Moss nursery planted forty seedlings; eighteen seedlings survived the observation week.
The second group is Reed nursery. Reed nursery planted sixty seedlings; forty-two seedlings survived the observation week.
Both nurseries define survival by the same end-of-week inspection. Each seedling belongs to exactly one nursery; no seedling is included in both groups.
Soil conditions and watering amounts were not measured. These counts cannot establish why survival proportions differ.

objective: 计算合并获批率与两个组的等权平均，并说明两者的权重以及比较的限制。

inputs.text: 虚构审核报告首先介绍晨光组。晨光组提交二十四张申请表，其中九张在周四前获批。
另一个群体是清泉组。清泉组提交三十六张申请表，其中二十七张在周四前获批。
两组均按同一审核规则，以本周周四为截止时间。每张申请表只属于一个组，两组不存在重复申请表。
申请内容的难度和完整程度未记录，不能据此确定两组获批率不同的原因。

objective: Calculate the combined completion proportion if both group totals are available.

inputs.text: The fictional report first lists Elm cohort. Elm cohort has thirty participants; twelve participants completed the module.
Pine cohort has twenty participants who completed the module. Its total number of participants was not recorded.
Both cohorts use the same module completion definition and Friday deadline. Each participant is assigned to exactly one cohort, with no participant shared.
Prior knowledge and study time are absent, so the counts cannot establish a cause for the difference in completion rates.

objective: 判断能否求两组独立参与者的合并完成率，并说明缺失条件。

inputs.text: 虚构记录先介绍朝阳组。朝阳组有三十名参与者，其中十二名完成任务。
映雪组有四十名参与者，其中二十四名完成任务。
两组都使用相同任务和同一周五截止时间。两组是否存在重复参与者尚未确定。
起点能力与练习时长未记录，不能解释完成率差异的原因。
